description: Tunable data for bandit gang generation (docs/js/bandit-gang-generator.js). No code lives here -- species/clothing pools, rank composition, mastery/difficulty scaling, and corpse loot are all data so gangs can be rebalanced without touching game.js.

clothingPool._comment: Slots + item ids intersected against each rolled species' own docs/config/species/<id>.json allowedCosmetics/cosmeticWeights at generation time -- a species that doesn't whitelist an item here (e.g. mashtzarr and hats) just never rolls it, no per-species override needed here.
clothingPool._dyeComment: Dye ids are constructed as `dye:CLOTH:<variant>_<hueFamily>` (see docs/config/scratchbones-config.js's catalog builder ~line 864-890, and appliedDyes samples in docs/config/npcs/hobunji-starter-npc-database.json) -- restricting variant to the mid/low-saturation set (60%/30% sat, darker brightness) gives the worn, mismatched look without needing the full runtime dye catalog. Each filled slot rolls its OWN variant+hue independently -- slots are never color-matched to each other.
clothingPool._fillComment: 3 slots x 0.5 = 1.5 average filled slots for a grunt, per design. Each slot is rolled independently; if a roll comes up with zero slots filled, one random slot is force-filled so every bandit wears at least one clothing item.

weaponMetalTierRangeByRank._comment: A bandit's actual held weapon: a random TOOL_SHAPE_DEFS shape (the same hatchet/fishing-mace/fishing-spear/pick-shovel improvised-weapon pool the player fights with -- this game has no dedicated 'sword' item) crafted from a random METAL_DEFS verdigris metal whose tier falls in this [min,max] range for the bandit's rank, bumped by +1 per difficulty tier (clamped to tier 7, tumbaga) -- 'their weapons have mastery ranks too, with randomly chosen upgrades, tied to their rank within the gang.' Drives both the rendered weapon prop and an attackDamage bump via game.js's own metalDmgMultiplier, and the weapon shape's own dmgType (sharp/blunt) replaces the flat hardcoded attackTag.

masteryBaseByRank._comment: Added to the current difficulty tier (see difficultyTiers below) and clamped to the tool mastery system's real 0-5 range (game.js MASTERY_XP_THRESHOLDS) to get a bandit's weapon mastery level.

heldAbilitiesByRank._comment: How many hold-family abilities (hold1/hold2 slots, see docs/js/combat/combat-loadout.js SLOT_CATEGORIES) this rank is given. Grunts get none (tap-only, weakest fighters); only the gang's lieutenants and captain fight with a held ability, and only the captain gets both slots filled.

statWeakenMultiplierByRank._comment: Applied to attackDamage/maxHealth relative to the tier-scaled captain baseline -- 'their abilities are weakened for all except their camp's bandit captain'.

difficultyTiers._comment: tier = floor(distanceFromWildernessEntrance / tierDistanceTiles), clamped to maxTier. Added to masteryBaseByRank per rank, and multiplies statWeakenMultiplierByRank's result by (1 + tier*tierStatBonus) so camps farther from town hit harder in both mastery-driven ability access and raw stats.

campLifecycle._comment: How many simultaneous camps a wilderness zone with bandit_camp locales can host, and camp-clearing state used by docs/js/temporary-locales.js release()/re-stamp.

corpseLoot._comment: Rolled the same way as any other creature death loot (game.js rollLootFromTable -- every entry always contributes its own min..max roll). Guaranteed worn-clothing drop is handled separately in code (100% of equippedCosmetics), not listed here.
